title: Articles (a / an / the)
description: We use articles before nouns. 'A' and 'an' are for general things. 'The' is for specific things.
examples: The office is near my home.
grammar_rules: Use 'the' for specific nouns both speaker and listener know
tips: Use 'an' before vowel sounds, not just vowel letters (an hour).
Use 'the' when talking about something specific.
